verdicts.reason: A gets the reading order backwards. The Pre-order CTA sits at the very top, above the price and the headline. The price floats off-centre and lines up with nothing. The teal backdrop circle has come apart from the headphones and now sits under the OBSIDIAN logo at the bottom, so the logo lands on a shape it was never meant to sit on. B keeps a sensible order (logo, price, headline, CTA), but the price hangs alone on the right with nothing near it. There is a large gap between the headline and the body copy, and the body copy wraps to leave 'battery.' on its own line. The teal circle is stranded empty in the bottom-left corner, and the price, headline and CTA do not share an edge. Both have serious flaws, but B is less broken.
